# Crate index

<p class="pm-kind"><b>Reference · generated</b> · every workspace crate by tier, with the description its manifest carries</p>

A tier depends only on the tiers below it; the peripheral surface depends on all of them and is depended on by none. The description column is each crate's `Cargo.toml` description, so this table is exactly what `cargo metadata` reports. The status column is the crate's `package.metadata.pulse-mesh.status`: `pre-integration` for a crate the tree ships but does not use yet (ADR-0014), `partial` for one in use some of whose public entry points return a deferred error (ADR-0017), blank for one that is finished and wired in.

## The fabric (tier 2, `mesh/`)

| Crate | Path | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mesh-basket` | `mesh/mesh-basket` |  | Pulse Mesh envelope basket: the daemon's SQLite capture of published envelopes, which pms-query and the MCP server's tools query by channel, time, type and origin. Tier 2 (the fabric). |
| `mesh-broadcast` | `mesh/mesh-broadcast` |  | Pulse Mesh BroadcastRegistry + ListenFilter: in-process fan-out of PulseEnvelopes to matching listeners. Tier 2 (the fabric). |
| `mesh-client` | `mesh/mesh-client` |  | Pulse Mesh — the Rust client for the daemon: `Mesh`, a synchronous handle over the Universal Port Protocol, with endpoint discovery, bounded queues, timed calls and callbacks on a thread of its own. Tier 2 (the fabric). |
| `mesh-health` | `mesh/mesh-health` |  | Pulse Mesh HealthRegistry: per-node heartbeat tracking that escalates a silent node through Healthy → Warning → Restarting → Isolated and reports drift as Degraded. Tier 2 (the fabric). |
| `mesh-hub` | `mesh/mesh-hub` |  | Pulse Mesh local daemon — terminates the universal port protocol over UDS + WebSocket. |
| `mesh-hub-runtime` | `mesh/mesh-hub-runtime` |  | Pulse Mesh embedded hub runtime — the event-bus library that mesh-hub (the daemon) wraps. |
| `mesh-link` | `mesh/mesh-link` |  | Pulse Mesh links between daemons, without a transport: qualified origins, interest summaries and their pacing, the forwarding decision, the forward cache, the hop limit and the link's control messages (ADR-0021). Tier 2 (the fabric). |
| `mesh-module-hub` | `mesh/mesh-module-hub` | pre-integration | Pulse Mesh child-hub abstraction — bridges a node's internal processing to a parent PulseHub. |
| `mesh-port-protocol` | `mesh/mesh-port-protocol` |  | Pulse Mesh Universal Port Protocol v0 — the wire types, the payload base64 codec and the Unix-socket framing shared by the daemon and its Rust clients. Tier 2 (the fabric). |
| `mesh-schema` | `mesh/mesh-schema` |  | Pulse Mesh schema registry — envelope-type ACLs and producer/consumer relationships. |

## The dev ring (tier 3, `dev_ring/`, `dev_ring/`)

| Crate | Path | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dev-core` | `dev_ring/dev-core` |  | Pulse Mesh — dev_ring core layer: shared types for the ring's functions and stages. Empty by design; kept so the four-crate shape is uniform. |
| `dev-functions` | `dev_ring/dev-functions` |  | Pulse Mesh — dev_ring functions layer: the basket re-export and the core_ops the pms command line and the MCP server share. |
| `dev-hub` | `dev_ring/dev-hub` |  | Pulse Mesh — dev_ring hub layer: the ring's import point; re-exports core, functions and stages, emits the ring manifest via `mesh_stage_registry::register_stages!`, and re-exports the Rust client (`mesh-client`) that lived here before ADR-0012. |
| `dev-stages` | `dev_ring/dev-stages` |  | Pulse Mesh — dev_ring stages layer: the symbol-keyed conflation router over a PulseRing. |

## The peripheral surface (tier peripheral, `tools/`, `examples/`)

| Crate | Path | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `multi-process` | `examples/multi-process` |  | Pulse Mesh template — two Rust processes (sender + receiver) over the local mesh-hub daemon. |
| `pms-cli` | `tools/pms` |  | pms — unified developer CLI for the Pulse Mesh Standard. |
| `pms-mcp` | `tools/pms-mcp` |  | Model Context Protocol server for the Pulse Mesh Standard. Exposes mesh introspection + the cross-language canonical codec proof to LLM agents. |
| `pms-telemetry-export` | `tools/pms-telemetry-export` |  | Pulse Mesh metrics exporter: Prometheus output for processes running the mesh. |
